*I study how plants adapt to environmental change from a functional and ecophysiological perspective, with a focus on Neotropical ecosystems. I also teach R and enjoy coding and working with data. Outside of science, I’m a mother of two girls, learning to see the world through their eyes every day.*



## Education

Bachelor of Forest Engineer, Universidade de Brasília | 2008

Master of Ecology, Universidade de Brasília | 2010

PhD in Plant Ecology, Macquarie University | 2014

Post Doctoral Fellow at Universidade de Brasília | 2015-2016

Post Doctoral Fellow at Universidade do Estado de Mato Grosso | 2016-2017

Post Doctoral Fellow at University of Oxford | 2018-2019

Post Doctoral Fellow at Universidade Federal do Paraná | 2019 - now
